wa_tatoosh.notes: SCOPE: own route, the one-pitch modern Tatoosh. It is the first pitch of the original 4-pitch Tatoosh, and Free at Last (wa_free_at_last, context) starts up it and continues past its anchor to a tree; the guide lists the two together as 'Tatoosh / Free at Last' (5.10b = Tatoosh's grade; its climb page is titled Tatoosh). MP also says the pitch was once called Free at Last. Higher Learning crosses it and Voyage of the Majestic Glass-eyed Tuna goes partway up the original upper Tatoosh. Not a duplicate (no other Tatoosh row in WA). Grade locked agree-2 (MP, guide, theCrag, Abegg). Length 34 m locked agree-2 (MP 110 ft, theCrag 110 ft). FA: MP 'unknown', stays null. SHAPE/UNSOURCED: variations holds 'A2 cracks to the flaring corner add an extra pitch (1985)'; no source I read mentions it; report only. theCrag's '110ft, 1' (likely a fixed-gear count) not used. SAFETY: MP says the original upper Tatoosh pitches were a funnel of debris with many loose blocks, and Free at Last's MP page notes a large perched block over the normal anchor; the stored hazard line is generic and no stored prose contradicts this. Not on or below the Great Northern Slab (2023 rockfall n/a).

wa_kunselman_s_physics.notes: SCOPE: own route (MP, guide, theCrag). One pitch high on the wall: it starts at the belay atop Higher Learning (wa_higher_learning), the same start as Path of Righteousness (wa_path_of_righteousness), traverses right past 2 bolts, goes up a groove into a flaring chimney, then back left and up a bolted headwall to the highest point of the Lower Town Wall. No safety warning on the page (exposed traverse only).
